items.title: Zverev wins the US Open and doesn't realize it
items.summary: Alexander Zverev beat Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6, 5-7, 6-2 to win his first US Open and his second major of the year, ending Shelton's run in his first Grand Slam final. On match point Zverev walked back to the baseline as if to play another point until the standing ovation told him it was over. The US Open's clip, captioned "HE DIDN'T REALIZE HE'D WON", got 42K likes, and Zverev told the crowd, "I know that today 99.9 per cent of the people wanted Ben to win, so I'm very sorry."
items.author: @usopen

post.name: US Open Tennis
post.text:
HE DIDN'T REALIZE HE'D WON 🏆

Alexander Zverev exorcises his 2020 demons and defeats Shelton 6-3, 7-6, 5-7, 6-2 to win his first US Open title!
